lines.en: Amara, we had waited for hours in this lobby before the receptionist finally came.
lines.pt: Amara, nós tínhamos esperado por horas neste saguão antes de a recepcionista finalmente aparecer.

lines.en: I know! We had been sitting here since noon, and nobody had even offered us water.
lines.pt: Eu sei! Estávamos sentados aqui desde o meio-dia, e ninguém sequer tinha nos oferecido água.

lines.en: When she appeared, she said our room hadn’t been cleaned yet.
lines.pt: Quando ela apareceu, disse que nosso quarto ainda não tinha sido limpo.

lines.en: I had been looking forward to a shower, so I was really annoyed.
lines.pt: Eu estava ansioso por um banho, então fiquei muito irritado.

lines.en: Before they gave us a different room, we had been waiting almost three hours.
lines.pt: Antes de nos darem outro quarto, estávamos esperando havia quase três horas.

lines.en: The manager apologised, and he had already arranged free breakfast for the next morning.
lines.pt: O gerente pediu desculpas, e já tinha providenciado café da manhã grátis para a manhã seguinte.

lines.en: That was kind. We had expected a sea view, but the window faced the car park.
lines.pt: Foi gentil. Esperávamos uma vista para o mar, mas a janela dava para o estacionamento.

lines.en: Well, by the time we unpacked, I had stopped complaining. The bed was very comfortable.
lines.pt: Bem, quando desfizemos as malas, eu já tinha parado de reclamar. A cama era muito confortável.

lines.en: I had been dreaming about the beach all week, so we went straight to the pier.
lines.pt: Eu vinha sonhando com a praia a semana toda, então fomos direto ao píer.

lines.en: And after we had walked along the seafront for an hour, we felt much better.
lines.pt: E depois de termos andado pela orla por uma hora, nos sentimos muito melhor.

lines.en: True. Long waits make you value small pleasures, as my grandmother had always said.
lines.pt: Verdade. Esperas longas fazem valorizar os pequenos prazeres, como minha avó sempre tinha dito.

facts.big: had waited / had been waiting + for + tempo + before
facts.label: Past perfect e esperas
facts.sub: Tinha esperado por horas: had waited for hours. Estava esperando havia: had been waiting. Antes de eles virem: before they came.

facts.label: Tinha esperado por
facts.sub: Had waited for + tempo mostra uma espera que terminou antes de outro momento: We had waited for hours before they came. Em português, “tínhamos esperado por horas”. Before liga com a ação posterior no passado simples.

facts.label: Estava fazendo havia
facts.sub: Had been + -ing destaca a duração da ação antes de outra: We had been waiting for three hours. Em português, “estávamos esperando havia três horas”. Use for ou since, nunca since com período.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “We had waited for hours before they came” means the waiting came first.
We cannot use had been + -ing for a long action.
items.why: We can: we had been waiting.

items.s: Before can introduce the later action.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “We had waited for hours before they came” means the waiting came fir… → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We cannot use had been + -ing for a long action. → Falso (We can: we had been waiting.)
Before can introduce the later action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A long wait in a hotel lobby · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy Saturday afternoon on the south coast, in Brighton. Dario and Noah finally lie on the beach, after a long day. Seagulls cry above the old pier. Their hotel had made them wait for a very long time. Now they laugh about it with ice cream in their hands. They tell the story of the lobby again.

“Noah, we had waited for hours in this lobby before the receptionist finally came.” says Dario. “I know! We had been sitting here since noon, and nobody had even offered us water.” says Noah. “When she appeared, she said our room hadn’t been cleaned yet.” says Dario.
